body.statement: For \(c^\dagger=(1,-1/4,-3/4)\), the eight pairs \((\theta_t,(\ell^\star)^\top b_t)\) in lexicographic type order are \[(0,0),\ (-3/4,-9/16),\ (-1/4,-1/16),\ (-1,-5/8),\ (1,5/8),\ (1/4,1/16),\ (3/4,9/16),\ (0,0).\] Hence \(b_{000}+b_{101}+b_{110}=v\), \(0+1/16+9/16=5/8\), \(\kappa(c^\dagger)=5/8\), and \(g^\star=(1,-1/10,-9/10)\). The transverse measures satisfy \(\sum_t\lambda_d^+(t)b_t=d^\dagger\), \(\sum_t\lambda_d^-(t)b_t=-d^\dagger\), total mass two, cost \(3/16\), and \((c^\dagger)^\top d^\dagger=0\). For each \(n\), \(\alpha_n\) is represented as the unique positive root of the square-free polynomial \(nX^3-1\) together with a rational isolating interval. If \(\alpha_n(3T+2\varepsilon)\le1\), then \(p_{n,x,h}^\dagger\) is a probability law and \[\mathbb E[b_t\mid x,h]=\alpha_n(xv+hd^\dagger),\quad \mathbb E[\theta_t\mid x,h]=\alpha_n x,\quad \tau_{c^\dagger}(m)=n^{-1}\sum_tm_t\theta_t.\] For rational \(T\) and \(\varepsilon\), the likelihood \(P_m(x^{\mathrm{obs}}\mid r)\) and target \(\tau_{c^\dagger}(m)\) are rational, while every \(\nu_{n,\varepsilon,T}^\dagger(m)\), \(D_{r,x}\), \(N_{r,x}\), \(S_{r,x}^\dagger\), \(\mathcal B_{n,\varepsilon,T}^\dagger(r)\), and \(B_{n,\varepsilon,T}^\dagger\) is obtained exactly as an ordered real algebraic number in \(\mathbb Q(\alpha_n)\). All signs and minima are certified by rational isolating-interval refinement.
body.justification: This exact eight-type calculation pins down the longitudinal and genuinely transverse directions before any asymptotic approximation is invoked.
body.gap: The accepted parent certifies same-sample orbit programs but does not supply this unequal-weight tube, while Sudijono, Dobriban, and Tchetgen Tchetgen have only four two-arm response types.
body.consumer: It is a primitive-level kill test for every later likelihood expansion and prevents a scalar prior from being substituted silently.
